defect: The fix extends the new pandas-mode NULL-string conversion to FetchDFChunk and factors out InitializeNumpyConversion; FetchDFChunk kept its previous behaviour.
reason: FetchDFChunk was not touched by this change and behaves as before, so the fix extends the feature (plus a test update) rather than repairing lines this change wrote.

defect: The fix only turns the empty-file-list BinderException into a D_ASSERT for coverage.
reason: A coverage cleanup of a guard, not the repair of a wrong result or crash.

defect: The fix adds an error for prepared parameters in non-final statements of a multi-statement execute (#7999).
reason: This change only passed stream_result=false to PendingQuery; the unsupported-parameter case existed before and is unrelated to that line.

defect: The fix removes the convenience SubqueryRef(QueryNode) constructor.
reason: Removing an extra but correct constructor is an API cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: GenerateAllColumnExpressions builds SELECT * column refs with table->name instead of the alias key, so SELECT * on an aliased table references a table name that is not bound.
reason: The new file introduced the line the fix changes to kv.first, and the alias-keyed map is visible in the same diff.

defect: The fix stops re-creating sink, operator and source states eagerly in the recursive CTE and only resets them (fuzzer 4.4).
reason: The eager GetGlobalSinkState/GetGlobalOperatorState calls predate the change, and ResetSource(true) re-creates the source just as the old Reset() did.

defect: ListSubSystems pre-sizes the vector with sub_systems.size() empty strings and then push_backs, returning empty names followed by the real ones.
reason: The warning cleanup introduced the sized constructor plus push_back that the fix corrects to indexed assignment.

defect: alias.extension == extension.name compares two const char pointers instead of the strings, so aliases are only found when identical literals happen to be pooled.
reason: The comparison was added in this change; seeing that both fields are const char* needs extension_helper.hpp.

defect: The fix only makes the UnsupportedWidth error message report the actual and maximum width.
reason: Error-message improvement with no behavioural defect.

defect: The interrupted_while_flushing flag added here is set on every sink block during flushing, so on resume the executor skips FinalExecute and re-pushes an already sunk chunk (or the wrong chunk once flushing_idx has advanced).
reason: The fix replaces this flag with blocked_on_have_more_output; the misuse sits in pipeline_executor.cpp of the same commit, not in the header declaration itself.

defect: The new resumable flush/execute state machine does not resume operators that still had output when the sink blocked (it only re-sinks final_chunk and advances flushing_idx before returning BLOCKED), so pending output is lost or pushed wrongly.
reason: The fix reworks exactly this logic from the WIP commit, whose own message admits a failing case.

defect: The fix rewrites Copy() from make_unique(move(expression->Copy())) to default construction plus assignment, labelled an OSX regression.
reason: Both forms are semantically equivalent, and whether the original line actually broke the OSX -Werror build cannot be confirmed from the repository.

defect: Flush bails out only when collection.count == 0, so when all locally appended rows were deleted it still calls InitializeAppend with zero rows and registers an empty append (issue #1091 internal error).
reason: The guard was introduced by this change and the fix changes it to count <= deleted_rows; why a zero-row append fails lives in DataTable and the commit path.

defect: The fix corrects the later sink-based LIMIT (offset accounting after slicing the input, chunks lying entirely before the offset) and adds a maximum-value check.
reason: Those bugs come from the later 'Turn limit into sink' rewrite; this change counted the unsliced input and emitted nothing before the offset.

defect: Wrapping ExecutePull in RunFunctionInTryCatch turns exceptions into executor.PushError and returns an empty chunk, and Executor::FetchChunk never checks for errors, so pull-mode errors are swallowed and results silently truncated.
reason: The fix restores rethrowing in ExecutePull; seeing that the caller ignores the pushed error requires executor.cpp.

defect: The fix removes the unused keys_entry and keys_entry_data locals added in InitializeVariants.
reason: Dead locals with no effect on results; the real resizing fixes of that commit are in from_json.cpp.

defect: The fix moves EXTRACT_NAMES handling before the catalog lookup so table names are extracted even for existing tables (#7093).
reason: This change was a mechanical make_unique to make_uniq rename; the EXTRACT_NAMES logic predates it.

defect: The fix drops the names[column_ids[i]] alias from the NOT NULL filter references, which went out of range once the loop iterated over index expressions.
reason: In this change the loop ran over scan columns and names held all table columns, so the lookup was valid; the overrun came with the later projection rewrite.

defect: The fix flips the comparison type when the constant is on the left of a range predicate used for an index scan.
reason: This change only handled COMPARE_EQUAL, which is symmetric; range predicates were added later in 92cbb93.

defect: GetFileName returns an empty string for any path ending in '..', so names such as '.a.b.c.d.e..' lose their file name and COPY to such a path breaks.
reason: The EndsWith('..') early return was added in this change and the fix removes it.

defect: MoveTmpFile rebuilds the target name by splitting the tmp path into stem and extension and stripping '_tmp', which does not round-trip (no extension gives a trailing dot, dotfiles like '.a.b' become '.a.b.b').
reason: The fix replaces this decomposition with a 'tmp_' prefix; the breakage also depends on the StringUtil helpers and the tmp naming in plan_copy_to_file.cpp.

defect: The fix updates the '..' test expectations to match the changed GetFileName and GetFileStem.
reason: Test-only change.

defect: A misplaced parenthesis nests the child == 0 && IsLeftOuterJoin test inside child == 1, so match tracking is never initialised for the left side of LEFT/FULL IE joins.
reason: The condition was rewritten in this change and the fix only moves the parenthesis.

defect: The fix renames transform_python_value to TransformPythonValue (and adds debug output).
reason: A rename is style; the function introduced here behaved correctly.

defect: The fix simplifies the EXCEPTION macro to report a DUCKDB_NODEJS_ERROR code instead of the 'xx' placeholder strings.
reason: The 'xx' placeholders came from intermediate commit 224923a, which had already removed this change's sqlite_code_string calls; the switch to an exported ERROR constant is an error-reporting redesign for the tests.

defect: Every column not used as key or aggregate gets a LAST payload aggregate even for recursive CTEs without USING KEY, so plain recursive CTEs acquire payload aggregates that alter their resolved types and bindings.
reason: The fix guards this new loop with !key_targets.empty(); the effect shows in LogicalRecursiveCTE::ResolveTypes and the planner.

defect: The fix adds a background thread that refreshes the ETA periodically when progress stalls.
reason: New feature, not a repair.

defect: The fix adds a statement-reuse leak test (and a hard-coded local library path).
reason: Test-only change.

defect: The fix removes the merge and distinct-combine events as part of a redesign of radix hash aggregate finalisation.
reason: This change only switched task vectors to shared_ptr; the fix is a refactor.

defect: The fix makes UnpinData public for the new hash aggregate source logic.
reason: Visibility change serving a redesign, no defect.

defect: The fix removes ScheduleTasks and makes Finalize return void as part of the source-phase redesign.
reason: Interface refactor.

defect: The fix casts n_rows to size_t in the loop comparison to silence a sign-compare warning.
reason: n_rows is a non-negative R length, so the comparison was correct; warning cleanup.

defect: The cast-error path reads buffer_handles.front()->requested_size, but Reset() clears buffer_handles at every new chunk, so front() can be called on an empty vector.
reason: The fix stores requested_size at construction instead; the clear happens in Reset(), outside the diff.

defect: The fix casts a floor() result to long in a test assertion to silence a clang warning.
reason: Test-only warning fix.

defect: The fix pads by chunk_col_id and parse_chunk.ColumnCount() to support projection pushdown with null_padding.
reason: chunk_col_id and projection pushdown did not exist in this change; indexing by cur_col_id was correct then.

defect: The fix changes the read_json parameters to Optional<py::object> and Optional<py::str> to remove type ambiguity.
reason: API typing change, not a defect in the added parameters.

defect: The fix changes the read_json wrapper parameters to Optional<> types to remove type ambiguity.
reason: API typing change made months later; the forwarding added here was correct.

defect: flatten references the grandchild vector and derives result offsets from a running counter, assuming child lists are contiguous and start at that offset, which breaks for sliced inputs or gaps and violates list-vector invariants.
reason: The fix replaces the reference with ListVector::Append copies and per-row source offsets, repairing the approach this initial implementation introduced.

defect: The new recursive, dictionary-cursor based ListLoopHash is buggy (it starts with HAS_RSEL ? rsel->get_index(i) : 0 and ignores idata.sel) and still mis-hashes nested lists of lists.
reason: The fix discards this algorithm and hashes only the list length because of that bug; the algorithm originates here, though the exact nested defect is not pinpointed.

defect: The fix changes a printf format from %lld to %ld for idx_t in output that only exists under DUCKDB_DEBUG_ALLOCATION.
reason: A format-warning tweak in opt-in debug code with no behavioural effect on 64-bit builds.
